warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport D200 Ingenium Diesel Timing Chain & Oil Dilution
paragraphs: Discovery Sport D200 engines with the Ingenium AJ200D diesel — across the L550 generation — commonly show timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks over time. This is a well-documented pattern on Ingenium diesel engines, confirmed by multiple specialist sources and owner forums. We replace timing chains, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every D200 rebuild.
The D200 (introduced in 2020) replaced the earlier D240 badge, but sits on the same Ingenium AJ200D engine family — the known issues apply across the full Ingenium diesel range.
warning.source: Source: shared Ingenium diesel family pattern (Discovery Sport/Evoque platform), per G-BRF-LandRover.md. Applies to all Ingenium diesel variants including D200
